How Does an Expandable Container House Work?

2024-06-06

With the rise of the prefab houses’ popularity, expandable container house is also getting the spotlight for being fully functional portable houses. Though you might think of their portability as the only benefit, there are loads more these houses offer. Moreover, their working and construction process is also quite interesting. So, if you are interested in exploring all about expandable container homes, this guide has got you covered.

 

In it, we have mentioned everything from the basics of expandable prefab homes to their working, construction process, perks, and the best place to get them. So, without any further ado, let’s begin exploring!

Types of Prefab Container Houses

Before delving deeper into the details about mobile expandable prefab house, let’s first have a look at the different types of prefab container houses!

Expandable Container House: These have modular structures and can be expanded from both ends to expand or reduce the overall living space.

Detachable Container House: These houses feature frames and wall panels that are entirely fixed with screws instead of welding. So, detaching them is quite easier for transportation and other purposes. These are often used as dormitories for workers on construction sites.

Folding Container House: These houses can be folded and unfolded for transportation. The retractable structure design is the most common among them, ensuring convenient mobility.  

   

What Do You Mean by an Expanding Container House?

Expandable container homes are more like shipping container frames with customized structures to be placed on-site in your chosen location. These portable prefab houses are like flatpacks that could be extended from both sides into a comfortable small living layout.

The best part about these houses is that you can get one made in your desired layout, be it one with a traditional layout or a modernized one. Moreover, as the structure is itself a basic shipping container, it can be easily transported to the desired location via rail, ship, or truck.

How Does the Construction Process of Expandable Prefab Homes Work?

All expandable prefab homes, be them 40ft or 20ft expandable container house, are entirely prefabricated. This means these are made off-site at centralized sections in factories and later assembled and installed on-site. The main components of these houses are a 20ft or 40ft flatpack with a folded roof, base, and wall on both sides when packed.

Plumbing and electricals are also embedded in the construction site. So, when on the site, all you need to do is expand the two sides and connect to extend the space from both ends. Flashing and shirting might also be needed.

These houses come in two sizes: a 40ft and 20ft expandable container home. A 40ft expandable container house has only around 74sqm building area whereas a 20ft one has around 36sqm. these houses can be stacked; these are used as a single house with optionally 2 or 4 bedrooms with a bathroom and a living area.

Different Layout of Expandable Container Homes

Aside from the size, the layout of the mobile expandable prefab house can also be varied. Basic options include:

· One bedroom with a bathroom, a small kitchen, and a living area.

· Two bedrooms with a bathroom, a small kitchen, and a living area.

· Three bedrooms with a bathroom, a small kitchen, and a living area (40ft).

· Four bedrooms with a bathroom, a small kitchen, and a living area (40ft).

· Four bedrooms with a bathroom, a small kitchen, a living area, and an extra balcony (40ft).

Why Get an Expandable Container House?

If you are intrigued to learn about the expandable container homes but wonder why you should get one, these exclusive perks will surely help you make an informed decision. Let’s have a look at them!

✔Get a Blank Canvas and Paint it Your Way!

What sets these houses apart is that they are like a blank canvas that can be painted the way you like. You can incorporate your unique taste and style into them by customizing their overall designs. Though there are pre-defined layouts, you can consult with your manufacturer to construct an expandable container house according to your design details.

Aside from the layout, the exterior finish, window styles, door designs, etc., all can be custom-made per your requirements. So, use this opportunity to unleash the home designer inside you. Just imagine the joy of living in a home that’s truly made for you.

✔Enjoy Flexibility and Mobility

Unlike site-built houses, these houses can be transported to wherever you want. You can even take them with you when relocating your residence for any reason, be it a sudden transfer to another city or just your need for a scenery change. This ease of flexibility and mobility adds to the overall significance of expandable shipping container homes, making them one of the best inventions of the modern world.

✔Cost-Effectiveness

You won't believe it, but prefab expandable houses are pretty much affordable and cost-effective alternatives to those expensive site-built houses. It's because the material utilized in their production is easily available and can be recycled. Moreover, the construction process is much quicker. For instance, where a site-built house will take multiple months to complete construction, these can be constructed in just a month. Thanks to advanced technologies, we have a chance to live in our dream houses without breaking the bank.

✔Embrace Sustainable Living

Are you into sustainable living and want to reduce your carbon footprint? Expanding container homes have got you covered. Most of these houses are prefabricated using recycled materials. Moreover, as these are manufactured in a factory, the reutilization of leftovers is also ensured. All this minimizes waste production, promoting sustainability.  

Aside from this, these houses are energy efficient. They feature top-notch insulation properties to regulate overall temperature and reduce the energy consumed when cooling or heating the house. This, in turn, reduced carbon dioxide emissions.

✔Enjoy Endless Possibilities

To sum up, the perks of getting yourself a mobile expandable prefab house are truly endless. Whether you want to get a sophisticated home office or just a cozy place to unwind, these houses have covered you. You can downsize them or expand them whenever needed, owing to the modular design. In short, the possibilities are only limited by your imagination. So, broaden your horizons and enjoy endless possibilities with an expandable container house.
